resources.description: An official CSFWD website tool that lets a concessionaire enter their account number to view billing/account information.
resources.function_note: This is an inquiry tool only. It is not an online-payment facility.
public_notes: Account numbers, query inputs, balances, due dates, disconnection results, and other returned customer information are never published or stored here.
This is not an online-payment channel; no payment capability is implied.
resources.title: Billing Inquiry

channels.walk_in: CSFWD Administrative/Finance Office or PrimeWater Commercial Office

resources.description: The Charter-wide channel for general customer feedback and complaints to CSFWD/PrimeWater management, distinct from technical maintenance reporting.
public_notes: Use this channel for general customer feedback and complaints. To report a technical water-supply or equipment concern (leaks, low pressure, water quality, meter issues), use Various MAINTENANCE Services instead.
A Facebook page is named in the Charter as an additional channel, but its exact current authenticated URL was not established and is not published.
Complaint contents and complainant information are never published.
resources.reply_standard: CSFWD/PrimeWater Management investigates and replies within three working days from receipt
resources.title: Feedback and Complaints Mechanism
